races.paceDynamic: Amiata appears the most natural front-runner with consistent early pace, while Joyful Tidings, Treasured Royal, Coincidental Glory, Wearing Stars, and This Guy all show prominent tendencies that could press forward early. With multiple prominent runners and only one clear leader, the pace should be genuine but not destructive over 6f on good to yielding ground. The strong prominent contingent will create a solid gallop that stretches the field, making it difficult for pure hold-up horses to make up ground in the straight. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can sit handy and kick, with the sustained pace likely to find out the pure hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent brigade settles well behind Amiata's lead
scenarios.body: The genuine pace plays perfectly into the hands of those tracking close, with Bad Boy Rizz and Joyful Tidings ideally positioned to strike. The hold-up horses find too much to do as the pace doesn't collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Amiata gets loose on the front with soft fractions
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader builds an unassailable advantage, with the chasing pack unable to peg back the margin despite late efforts. Prominent runners pick up the pieces behind.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Charge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes unsustainably fast between prominent runners
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final furlong allowing Allsortz and One Cool Bear to unleash telling late kicks. The early leaders pay for their exuberance.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Compromise Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If tactical riding sees the pace become stop-start
scenarios.body: The muddling tempo suits versatile types who can adapt their position and running style. Mid-division horses find gaps as the race opens up.

watchPoints.text: Amiata could steal this if getting uncontested lead as prominent rivals may be reluctant early pace-makers

Hold-up horses Allsortz and One Cool Bear need strong pace to be effective but may find too much to do
First-time headgear on Bad Boy Rizz, Wearing Stars and This Guy suggests all three expected to show improvement

races.paceDynamic: Valiant Force is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the rail, likely setting a measured tempo over this 6f trip with no early pressure expected. The prominent runners Headmaster, Howd'yadoit, Staysound Susie, Indigo Dream and Bishopton will track the leader in a bunch, while the majority of the field are hold-up horses including Tango Flare, Heavenly Power, City House, Keke, Go Athletico, Nezeeh and Billie Be Quick who will need to come from off the pace. With 10 of 13 runners preferring to come from behind and only one true pace-setter, this creates a tactical advantage for the hold-up horses who should get the galloping finish they need. This race shape strongly favours closers and hold-up performers who can benefit from the modest early pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Valiant Force sets steady fractions as expected with no pace pressure
scenarios.body: The large hold-up contingent gets the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks in the final 2f. Quality closers like Tango Flare and Heavenly Power can exploit their superior RPR figures in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Victory
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners position perfectly behind the modest pace
scenarios.body: Headmaster or Howd'yadoit can strike first turning for home before the hold-up horses fully wind up. Their tactical positioning gives them first run on the leaders while avoiding traffic issues.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Persists
scenarios.trigger: If Valiant Force's recent 141lb burden proves manageable and the pace stays too slow
scenarios.body: The leader maintains enough in reserve to resist late challenges despite carrying top weight. A pedestrian gallop throughout plays into his hands as a natural front runner.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners advance simultaneously creating a muddling middle section
scenarios.body: The race becomes scrappy with uneven pace changes that compromise several fancied runners' finishing kicks. Outsiders with tactical speed like Indigo Dream can capitalize on the confusion.

watchPoints.text: Valiant Force could fold quickly if 141lbs proves too much burden combined with his woeful going record

Multiple hold-up horses could get in each other's way in the final furlong creating traffic problems

races.paceDynamic: Bonus Time is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the gates, likely getting an uncontested lead in this large field. The prominent racers Bucanero Fuerte, Mission Central, and King Cuan will settle just behind, but none are aggressive enough to pressure the leader early. This creates a moderate tempo that builds gradually, with the large contingent of hold-up horses including Thunderbear, Kerdos, and Getreadytorumble needing to navigate traffic from the back. The race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions early, as the hold-up brigade will struggle for clear runs in a competitive 16-runner field over the minimum trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Bonus Time gets a soft lead and maintains stamina
scenarios.body: Bonus Time controls the pace without pressure and kicks clear in the final furlong, with Mission Central and Bucanero Fuerte chasing home from their tracking positions. The hold-up horses get caught in traffic and arrive too late over this sharp 5f trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow for Bonus Time's finishing kick
scenarios.body: Mission Central or Bucanero Fuerte capitalizes on superior class ratings, with Ryan Moore timing his challenge perfectly aboard the Ballydoyle runner. The moderate early pace allows these quality horses to demonstrate their superior turn of foot in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Gets Lucky
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and clear runs emerge
scenarios.body: Thunderbear or King Cuan benefits from a messy pace scenario and finds the perfect passage through the field. Their superior recent form and higher ratings tell as they sweep past tiring leaders in the final 100 yards.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites underperform and the pace suits a closer
scenarios.body: Cardiff By The Sea uses his 3yo weight allowance to full effect, or Fahrenheit Seven's recent wins on similar ground propel him forward. The race fragments enough for one of these consistent performers to capitalize on the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Bonus Time must break cleanly to secure the early lead, as any hesitation allows prominent runners to pressure him
Mission Central's 178-day layoff after promising 2yo form requires close monitoring for sharpness on return
Traffic problems inevitable with 16 runners over 5f - watch how hold-up horses Thunderbear and King Cuan get positioned early
Ground conditions have eased to Good To Yielding throughout the card, favoring horses with soft ground experience
Ryan Moore choosing Mission Central over other Ballydoyle options suggests stable confidence despite the layoff

races.paceDynamic: Jamestown will lead uncontested from the start with no other confirmed front runners in the field. Controlled, Trojan Warrior and Bobby McGee will settle prominently behind the leader, creating a moderate early gallop at best. The lack of pace pressure means Jamestown can dictate terms while the large contingent of hold-up horses (Son Of Beauty, Manton Bay, Alphecca, How'sthebai, Invincible Will) will be relying on a strong finish. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners and the lone leader, as the lack of early pace will make it difficult for hold-up horses to close effectively.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leader Dictates Terms
scenarios.trigger: If Jamestown maintains steady fractions without being pressured early
scenarios.body: Jamestown controls the tempo and has enough left to hold off late challenges, while prominent runners get ideal positioning. The lack of pace pressure allows the leader and those close up to dominate the finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Controlled or Bobby McGee travel smoothly behind Jamestown and kick clear
scenarios.body: The experienced prominent runners use their tactical speed to strike at the right moment while Jamestown tires from leading. Their form edge tells in a moderate pace scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Flies Home
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens mid-race as prominent horses pressure Jamestown
scenarios.body: A genuine gallop develops allowing the closers to get into contention, with Alphecca or Invincible Will using their proven finishing kicks. The race opens up for late runners with the best turn of foot.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Outsider Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: An unconsidered runner like Felix Guido or How'sthebai finds the right trip in slowly-run conditions. The race becomes a lottery favouring those with untapped potential or fresh legs.

watchPoints.text: Jamestown could steal this if allowed uncontested lead as no other front runners will apply early pressure
Watch for Controlled and Bobby McGee positioning early as they have the tactical speed to strike from prominent positions
The large group of hold-up horses could struggle if Jamestown sets steady fractions without being challenged
Monitor how quickly Felix Guido shows after 233-day absence as lightly raced horses can improve significantly
Track Alphecca's early positioning as 197-day break might leave him needing the run despite previous ability
